parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> To view details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region, including their IDs, call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace. Default value: public.

> To create a namespace, call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation. To list namespaces, call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation.

parameters.name: NamespacePassword
parameters.description:
The password for the namespace.

> You set this password when you call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance resides.
